evidence_kind: Human-authored summary of ordinary static javap observations; no runtime or REA Evidence claim
artifact_identity: Exact dependency versions and AAR SHA-256 values are recorded in inventory.json
publication_boundary: Class/method identities, concise observed authorization predicates and limits only. Full implementation transcripts are retained privately in ignored .android-local and are not distributed.

observations: Only the exact ACTION_BIND_SDK_SERVICE action returns the SDK binder
Each public AIDL operation verifies the caller before scheduling worker work
The supplied package must belong to Binder.getCallingUid() according to PackageManager
The package must equal com.google.android.apps.healthdata
The permitted operations concern the SDK permission token or app foreground state
limits: Complete Health Connect token protocol and replacement-provider scenarios were not tested

observations: Service is disabled in the merged manifest
If enabled, binding returns the SDK extraction binder
Clear-storage and service-state operations verify the installed Play Store and Binder caller before effects
Service-state input is handled through fixed SDK action types
Caller UID must resolve to a package set containing com.android.vending
Installed Play Store must be enabled and match a supported signer digest
The alternative development signer is conditional on development/test build tags
limits: Installed device signer state, dynamic component enabling and full extraction behavior were not tested

observations: Manifest requires INSTALL_PACKAGES
Handler requires a flags bundle, the enableWorkManager flag and a session-state bundle before SDK asset handling
limits: No asset work executed; downstream extraction not exhaustively reviewed

observations: Manifest requires BIND_JOB_SERVICE
Job entry resolves WorkSpec and generation from platform JobParameters
Missing work identity and duplicate active jobs are rejected
limits: Runtime scheduler and all downstream workers were not tested

observations: Manifest requires DUMP
A received request schedules the SDK DiagnosticsWorker
No incoming file, URI or SQL parameter is used at this entry
limits: No diagnostics executed; installed OS permission ownership not runtime-tested

observations: Manifest requires DUMP
Handler selects fixed profile-install, skip-file, save-profile or benchmark operations
Entry branches act on the app's profile, skip or cache state; no arbitrary supplied file path was found
limits: No profiling, signal or cache operation executed
